title: Patients-like-me: A Variational LM--GNN Framework for Explainable Clinical Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.04193v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Language models (LMs) offer strong textual representations for electronic health records (EHRs), but they encode patient sequences in isolation and provide limited explainability. Graph neural networks (GNNs) complement LMs by incorporating inter-patient relationships and enabling reference-patient attribution, yet they rely on high-quality patient representations. We propose Patients-like-me (PLM), a unified LM--GNN framework that integrates local patient semantics with global cohort structure. To train PLM efficiently, we introduce a Variational Expectation-Maximization algorithm that alternates LM and GNN updates under a supervised variational objective. Extensive experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV show that PLM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with improvements generalizing across encoder-only and decoder-only LM backbones. These gains are achieved with only modest additional computational overhead. PLM

translated_title: Patients-like-me：一种用于可解释临床预测的变分语言模型-图神经网络框架
translated_abstract: 语言模型（LMs）为电子健康记录（EHRs）提供了强大的文本表示能力，但它们孤立地对患者序列进行编码，且可解释性有限。图神经网络（GNNs）通过纳入患者间关系并实现参考患者归因来补充语言模型，但其性能依赖于高质量的患者表示。我们提出了Patients-like-me（PLM），一个统一的LM-GNN框架，将局部患者语义与全局队列结构相整合。为了高效训练PLM，我们引入了一种变分期望最大化算法，在监督变分目标下交替进行LM和GNN的更新。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上的大量实验表明，PLM持续优于最先进的方法，且这些改进能够泛化到仅编码器（encoder-only）和仅解码器（decoder-only）等不同类型的语言模型骨干网络。这些性能提升仅需适度的额外计算开销。
tldr: 提出了统一的LM-GNN框架PLM，通过变分期望最大化算法将患者局部语义与全局队列结构相融合，以适度的计算开销实现了更优性能和可解释性的临床预测。
